name: HGSS Visual Overhaul
author: LucianoNeo
description: HGSS intro and overworld overhaul for Gen 1 and Gen 2. PLAYER SELECT controls matching Red, Ash, Ethan, Lyra, Kris, Kris V2, Leaf or Brendan walking, bicycle, fishing and battle-back assets. Gen 2 TRAINER ART includes matching HGSS portraits for leaders and Route 34 classes; Gen 2 battle Pokémon remain native.
